title: Seffa and Brussels Sprouts Tagine
description: A flavorful Moroccan-inspired stew featuring seffa, Brussels sprouts, and crunchy elements.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Brussels sprouts and cook until they start to brown, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the Moroccan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the seffa and 2 cups of water to the pan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped almonds and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional almonds if desired.
